name: community/fftw
description: FFI bindings to the native FFTW3 library (double + single precision) via HostLibs.

native.note: runtime dependency loaded via HostLibs; must be present on the host/container to run (compile-only needs nothing).

residual: The bindings needed HostLibs, which no package claimed and the payload therefore lacked until 2026-08-24: until then nothing in this package compiled at all. Both test programs compile too, and are left out as tests.

excludes.FFTWTest: a test program, not part of the binding
excludes.FFTWTestf: a test program, not part of the binding
